links.comparator_used: Standard LLM setting without knowledge graph retrieval (no retrieval)
links.outcome: Performance across five EpiBench tasks (clinical decision-making, EEG report generation, pharmacogenomic precision medicine, treatment recommendation, deep research planning) across six LLMs
links.effect: Integrating EpiGraph consistently improves performance across all tasks, with the largest gains in pharmacogenomic reasoning (+30--41%)
links.quote: Results show that integrating \textsc{EpiGraph} consistently improves performance across all tasks, with the largest gains observed in pharmacogenomic reasoning (+30--41\%).
